name: Bengaluru–Mysuru Expressway
lanes: 6-lane main carriageway, access-controlled, with service roads on both sides

tolls.name: Kaniminike toll plaza
tolls.note: near Bidadi, on the Bengaluru side

tolls.name: Gananguru toll plaza
tolls.note: on the Mysuru side of the expressway

timeline.event: Construction begins on upgrading the old Bengaluru–Mysuru road
Inaugurated by the Prime Minister in March 2023

history: The road between Bengaluru and Mysuru was once a crowded state highway that took about three hours to drive. It was rebuilt as a wide, access-controlled expressway on National Highway 275 and opened in March 2023. New bypasses now carry the expressway around towns like Ramanagara, Channapatna, Maddur, Mandya and Srirangapatna, so through traffic no longer has to squeeze through their streets.
facts: Cut the Bengaluru–Mysuru drive from about 3 hours to roughly 75–90 minutes.
Part of NH 275, which continues beyond Mysuru towards Kodagu and coastal Karnataka.
Built with bypasses around six towns along the old road.
The main carriageway has 6 lanes, with separate service roads for local traffic.
